# Globus Developers

> Globus Developers builds luxury homes across Hyderabad's growth corridors: high-rise apartments, villas and a township. Office: Puppalguda, Hyderabad, Telangana.

Contact: +91 95 1978 1978 · +91 040 6975 3333 · info@globusdevelopers.com

## Projects

- [Neo](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/neo): Neopolis, Kokapet. 3 & 4 BHK apartments in two towers, 2,235 to 4,565 sft. Ongoing. TG RERA P02400010006.
- [Altus](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/altus): Kondapur. 3 & 4 BHK apartments. Ongoing. TG RERA P02400008439.
- [Treasor](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/treasor): Kokapet. 3 & 4 BHK apartments, including duplexes. Ongoing. TG RERA P02400003226.
- [Floresta](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/floresta): Pati, Kollur. 3 & 4 BHK apartments and G+2 triplex villas. Ongoing. TG RERA P01100007551.
- [Westlyn](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/westlyn): Hyderabad. Villas. Upcoming.
- [Tukkuguda](https://www.globusdevelopers.com/projects/tukkuguda): South Hyderabad. Globus Township. Upcoming.
